answer: Juries must be diverse or the verdict dies. Draw signers from distinct subnetworks, distinct stake sizes, distinct join epochs. A panel that clusters gets voided and the claim re-queued. Every claim is then re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain from it passing. Spin up fifty keys off one glacier host and you get fifty keys that cannot sit on the same jury, so the vault of cheap votes buys nothing but a violet audit trail.
